registry.project: Matsui customer service — low-latency hybrid multi-agent POC (email + chat)

id_scheme.BR-nn: Business requirement (why). Traced down to child FR/NFR ids.
id_scheme.FR-<AREA>-nn: Functional requirement. AREA: CH chat, EM email, OR orchestration, RT routing & guardrails, CA cache, RG retrieval/RAG, KG knowledge graph, AG agents & tools, VF verification, HO human handoff & console, KB knowledge ops & upload, UI user interface
id_scheme.NFR-<CAT>-nn: Non-functional requirement. CAT: PERF, QUAL, SEC, OBS, REL, MNT, DEP, COST
id_scheme.BS-nn: Build step in LLD.html (source of truth: docs/build-steps.json)
id_scheme.TC-<req-id>: Test case id that verifies the requirement
id_scheme.D-nnn / OD-nnn: Design decision / open decision (HLD section 6/7, mirrored in DECISIONS.md)

rules: IDs are permanent. Never renumber; deprecate with status 'deprecated' and a 'replaced_by' field.
trace.build_steps and trace.tests are generated by tools/sync_docs.py from build-steps.json; do not hand-edit them.
Every FR/NFR/DR must be implemented by at least one build step; every BR must list children.

requirements.title: Deflect routine queries over email and chat
requirements.statement: The POC shall show that routine Matsui customer queries (FAQs, troubleshooting, ticket/AMC status, spare parts) can be answered automatically over email and chat under Matsui branding.
acceptance: Demo covers all 10 sample emails and 10 chat scripts end to end
Deflection rate reported on the analytics page

requirements.title: Low latency through a hybrid rule + AI design
requirements.statement: The POC shall demonstrate measurably lower latency than a single-LLM baseline by answering as many requests as possible from deterministic rules and caches before calling large models.
acceptance: Analytics shows latency per tier and versus a single-agent baseline run on the eval set

requirements.title: Trustworthy, grounded answers with safe escalation
requirements.statement: Answers shall be grounded in Matsui knowledge with visible sources; uncertain, unsafe or sensitive cases shall go to a human.
acceptance: Groundedness and hallucination metrics reported
All safety eval items handed to humans

requirements.title: Update knowledge live during the demo
requirements.statement: An admin shall be able to upload new documents and structured data during a live demo and see answers change without a redeploy.
acceptance: requires_upload eval items flip from 'no information' to correct after upload

requirements.title: Voice-ready core (voice deferred)
requirements.statement: The core shall be channel-agnostic so that a voice channel can be added later reusing the chat fast path.
acceptance: No channel-specific logic inside orchestrator nodes; channel policy is configuration

requirements.title: Compare RAG and graph RAG for multi-hop questions
requirements.statement: The POC shall produce a reproducible comparison of vector RAG, KG-RAG and hybrid retrieval on single- and multi-hop questions.
acceptance: Benchmark report generated from eval/questions.jsonl

requirements.title: Streaming chat widget
requirements.statement: The help centre shall include a chat widget that streams assistant responses token by token.
acceptance: First token or status message visible within the NFR-PERF-01 budget
Widget opens from a launcher on every help-centre page

requirements.title: Multi-turn sessions
requirements.statement: Chat shall keep conversation context across turns (active agent, entities such as model/serial, open slots) and persist transcripts.
acceptance: Follow-up 'and the rotor?' resolves against previous turn (CH-001)
Reloading the page resumes the session

requirements.title: Source citations in chat
requirements.statement: Every knowledge-based chat answer shall show citation chips that open the cited KB article section or KG fact.
acceptance: T1/T2/T3 answers render at least one citation
Clicking a chip opens the article anchor

requirements.title: Quick replies and actions
requirements.statement: Chat shall offer contextual quick replies (raise service request, check ticket, talk to a human, related questions).
acceptance: Quick replies returned in the SSE 'actions' event and rendered as buttons

requirements.title: In-chat structured forms for slot filling
requirements.statement: When an agent needs structured data (serial number, contact, preferred date) chat shall render a validated inline form instead of free-text back-and-forth.
acceptance: Serial validated against regex and asset table before submission
CH-004 creates a ticket in at most 4 turns

requirements.title: Answer feedback
requirements.statement: Users shall rate each answer (helpful / not helpful with optional reason); ratings are stored against the trace.
acceptance: Feedback row linked to trace_id
Shown on analytics

requirements.title: English and Hinglish understanding
requirements.statement: The router and answerers shall understand English and romanised Hinglish queries and reply in clear English (OD-008 → D-030: English even when the user writes only in Hinglish).
acceptance: CH-007 and Hinglish FAQ paraphrases route to the correct intent

requirements.title: Inbound email ingestion and threading
requirements.statement: The system shall ingest inbound emails through an adapter interface: a built-in demo mailbox (Postgres-backed inbox/outbox, for dev, tests and offline demos) and a Gmail API adapter (demo mailbox with Pub/Sub push notifications to Cloud Run, replies sent via Gmail API). Messages are threaded by Message-ID/In-Reply-To/References and ticket reference in subject.
acceptance: Replies on an existing thread attach to the same conversation
Duplicate delivery is idempotent (same Message-ID processed once)

requirements.title: Multi-question decomposition
requirements.statement: An email containing several questions shall be decomposed into sub-queries that are routed and answered in parallel, then merged into one reply.
acceptance: EM-004 reply answers all 3 questions with separate citations

requirements.title: Auto-send or review queue
requirements.statement: Email replies shall be auto-sent only when confidence is at or above the email threshold and no policy flag is raised; otherwise a draft goes to the human review queue.
acceptance: EM-003 and EM-008 go to review/handoff, EM-004 auto-sends (with default thresholds)

requirements.title: Sender identification
requirements.statement: The sender shall be matched to a customer by exact contact email, then by email domain; unknown senders get only public-knowledge answers and no account data.
acceptance: EM-007 (unknown sender) receives no customer data

requirements.title: Branded reply template
requirements.statement: Replies shall use a Matsui-branded template with greeting, answer sections, source footnotes, ticket reference and signature.
acceptance: HTML and plain-text parts generated
Subject keeps 'Re:' and ticket reference

requirements.title: Attachment handling
requirements.statement: Attachments shall be stored in a GCS bucket (all environments) and listed to the human agent; they are not parsed by AI in this POC.
acceptance: Attachment metadata visible in agent console

requirements.title: Channel-agnostic message envelope
requirements.statement: All channels shall convert inbound messages into one normalized envelope (channel, conversation, customer, text, attachments, metadata) before orchestration.
acceptance: Orchestrator code has no imports from channel adapters

requirements.title: Code-based orchestrator
requirements.statement: Orchestration shall be a deterministic state graph (LangGraph) where routing edges are code; LLMs are used only inside specific nodes.
acceptance: No LLM call on the T0/T1 path
Graph definition renders to a diagram

requirements.title: Tiered cascade with early exit
requirements.statement: Requests shall flow through tiers T0 (rules/tools), T1 (FAQ cache), T2 (single-call RAG), T3 (agentic multi-hop), T4 (human), exiting at the first tier that answers with sufficient confidence; the answering tier is recorded.
acceptance: Every trace has answered_tier
Expected tiers in eval achieved for at least 85% of items

requirements.title: Per-channel policy profiles
requirements.statement: Latency budget, verification mode (sync/async), auto-send rule and allowed tiers shall come from a per-channel policy profile (chat, email, voice-later).
acceptance: Changing policy YAML changes behaviour without code changes

requirements.title: Specialist handoffs persist across turns
requirements.statement: When a specialist agent owns a chat conversation, follow-up turns go directly to it until it hands back or off, skipping re-routing unless the rule layer detects an intent switch.
acceptance: CH-002 turns 2–3 skip the router (trace shows 'sticky_agent')

requirements.title: Timeouts and graceful degradation
requirements.statement: Each node shall have a timeout from the channel budget; on timeout or provider error the orchestrator falls back (lower tier answer with caveat, or handoff) instead of failing.
acceptance: Fault-injection test: LLM timeout produces a handoff message within budget

requirements.title: Deterministic rule layer
requirements.statement: A rule layer shall extract entities with regex/dictionaries (ticket ids, serials, AMC ids, model names, error codes and display texts, cities) and handle exact intents (greetings, 'talk to human', ticket status with id).
acceptance: Entity extraction F1 at least 0.95 on eval items containing ids
Rule layer p95 under 10 ms

requirements.title: Embedding intent classifier
requirements.statement: An embedding kNN classifier over labelled example utterances shall predict intent with a confidence score.
acceptance: Accepted when confidence at or above tau_intent (default 0.80)

requirements.title: Small-LLM fallback router
requirements.statement: When rules and classifier are not confident, a fast LLM shall classify intent(s) and entities into a JSON schema, supporting multiple intents per message.
acceptance: Schema-valid output 100% (retry once on invalid)
EM-001 yields two intents

requirements.title: Safety triggers
requirements.statement: Safety keywords and classifier signals (smoke, burning, shock, fire, injury, refrigerant leak) shall immediately produce safety instructions and a P1 human handoff.
acceptance: All safety eval items and EM-008 trigger P1 handoff

requirements.title: Prompt-injection, exfiltration and out-of-scope handling
requirements.statement: Inputs shall be screened for prompt injection and requests for other customers' data or system instructions; out-of-scope requests get a polite redirect.
acceptance: All adversarial and out-of-scope eval items handled without leakage
Retrieved content is treated as data (no instruction following from documents)

requirements.title: PII redaction in logs
requirements.statement: Phone numbers, emails and GSTIN shall be masked in logs and traces (raw text kept only in the conversation store).
acceptance: Log scan test finds no unmasked phone/email

requirements.title: Exact-match answer cache
requirements.statement: Normalized query text (lowercase, punctuation and whitespace stripped) shall be looked up in an exact-match cache of approved public answers.
acceptance: Hit returns in under 20 ms server time

requirements.title: Semantic FAQ cache
requirements.statement: Queries shall be embedded and matched against FAQ questions and paraphrases; similarity at or above tau_cache (default 0.90) returns the curated answer with its source.
acceptance: At least 85% of faq_paraphrase eval items served by T1 with correct answer
False-hit rate under 3% on non-FAQ eval items

requirements.title: Cache invalidation on knowledge change
requirements.statement: Cache entries shall record their source documents; updating, superseding or deleting a source invalidates dependent entries.
acceptance: Superseding a policy removes cached answers that cite it

requirements.title: No caching of personal or transactional answers
requirements.statement: Answers that depend on customer identity, account data or real-time stock shall never be written to or served from the cache.
acceptance: Cache writer rejects entries with customer-scoped flag

requirements.title: Promote verified answers to cache
requirements.statement: Agents/admins shall be able to promote a reviewed answer to the FAQ cache from the console.
acceptance: Promoted answer served on the next similar query

requirements.title: Hybrid lexical + vector retrieval
requirements.statement: Retrieval shall combine Postgres full-text search and pgvector similarity using reciprocal rank fusion.
acceptance: Recall@5 at least 0.9 on single_hop gold docs

requirements.title: Structure-aware chunking
requirements.statement: Documents shall be chunked by heading hierarchy, keeping tables and each error-code section intact, with heading path and anchors stored per chunk.
acceptance: No table split across chunks
Each manual error-code section maps to exactly one chunk

requirements.title: Metadata filtering
requirements.statement: Retrieval shall filter by document status (active by default), doc type and product family/model when the router extracted them.
acceptance: Query naming DHD-150 retrieves no MTC manual chunks

requirements.title: Reranking
requirements.statement: Top candidates shall be reranked (cross-encoder by default) before generation, keeping at most k_ctx chunks.
acceptance: MRR improves versus no-rerank on eval (reported)

requirements.title: Cited generation with abstention
requirements.statement: The answerer shall cite evidence ids for every factual claim and say it has no information when the context does not support an answer.
acceptance: requires_upload items answered with abstention before upload
Citation format [doc_id#chunk] or [kg:path_id]

requirements.title: Version-aware retrieval
requirements.statement: Superseded documents shall be excluded unless the user asks about a past date or previous policy.
acceptance: version_trap eval item cites v2 and never v1

requirements.title: Product knowledge graph
requirements.statement: A Neo4j graph shall hold product knowledge (families, models, components, error codes, causes, resolutions, parts, stock, service centres, AMC coverage, documents) per the schema in LLD-4.
acceptance: Seed load produces the node/edge counts in mock-data SUMMARY.json

requirements.title: Entity linking
requirements.statement: Mentions in queries (model ids, error codes, display texts such as 'DEW PT HIGH', part numbers, cities) shall be linked to KG node ids using dictionaries first, then full-text index, then embedding similarity.
acceptance: Linking accuracy at least 0.95 on multi_hop eval items

requirements.title: Parameterized multi-hop query templates
requirements.statement: Common reasoning patterns (diagnose error, parts for cause, stock at warehouse, nearest service centre, AMC coverage of part, shared causes) shall be answered with parameterized Cypher templates.
acceptance: Template queries p95 under 50 ms on seed data

requirements.title: Guarded Text2Cypher fallback
requirements.statement: Questions not covered by templates may use LLM-generated Cypher that is validated against the schema, read-only, and LIMITed, executed with a read-only user and timeout.
acceptance: Write clauses (CREATE/MERGE/DELETE/SET/CALL dbms) rejected
Timeout 2 s

requirements.title: Hybrid GraphRAG evidence
requirements.statement: T3 answers shall combine KG paths (as structured facts with path ids) and RAG chunks (linked via DOCUMENTED_IN) into one evidence set.
acceptance: Multi-hop answers cite at least one KG path and, where available, the manual chunk

requirements.title: Retrieval benchmark mode
requirements.statement: The eval harness shall run each question in RAG-only, KG-only and hybrid modes and record accuracy, groundedness, latency and tokens.
acceptance: Report HTML/CSV produced by `make eval`

requirements.title: Troubleshooting agent
requirements.statement: A troubleshooting specialist shall diagnose error codes and symptoms using KG-RAG, ask at most one clarifying question (e.g. model), give safe customer-doable steps first and offer a service request when a technician is needed.
acceptance: CH-002, CH-005, EM-001, EM-006, EM-010 produce correct likely cause and next step

requirements.title: Service request agent
requirements.statement: A service request flow shall collect serial, issue/error code and contact via slot filling, compute priority by rules (safety_stop or production stopped gives P1) and create a ticket.
acceptance: Ticket id returned to the user; ticket visible in console

requirements.title: Account lookup tools
requirements.statement: Tools shall return ticket status, asset details, warranty status and AMC contract status for the identified customer.
acceptance: All transactional eval items correct
T0 path p95 under 300 ms

requirements.title: Spare parts agent
requirements.statement: A parts specialist shall resolve compatible parts for a model/serial, report price, stock per warehouse, nearest warehouse to the customer and lead time, and create a parts quote request (no payment).
acceptance: EM-005 answer includes part no, price, availability for Ludhiana's supplying warehouse

requirements.title: Sales lead capture
requirements.statement: Purchase or quotation requests shall be captured as leads (product, application, throughput, location, contact) and routed to a sales queue with an acknowledgement.
acceptance: EM-002 creates a lead with extracted fields

requirements.title: Customer-scoped tool access
requirements.statement: Account tools shall enforce that the requested record belongs to the identified customer; the LLM never receives other customers' records.
acceptance: Adversarial item asking for Orion's AMC price refused
Unit tests for scope checks

requirements.title: Citation coverage check
requirements.statement: Each sentence with a factual claim in a draft answer shall reference at least one evidence id; uncovered sentences are removed or trigger regeneration.
acceptance: Coverage metric logged per answer

requirements.title: Grounding judge
requirements.statement: An LLM judge shall score faithfulness of the answer to the evidence (0–1); sync for email, async/sampled for chat.
acceptance: Judge agrees with human labels on at least 85% of a 50-item calibration set

requirements.title: Entity and number consistency rules
requirements.statement: Part numbers, prices, error codes, ticket ids and dates in an answer shall be checked against DB/KG; mismatches block sending.
acceptance: Injected wrong part number in a draft is caught

requirements.title: Confidence score and handoff decision
requirements.statement: A confidence score shall combine router confidence, retrieval scores, verifier results and policy flags; below the channel threshold the system hands off (chat) or drafts for review (email).
acceptance: Thresholds configurable per channel
Score and components stored in trace

requirements.title: Async chat audit
requirements.statement: A background job shall run the full grounding judge on a sample (default 20%) of chat answers and flag low scores on the analytics page.
acceptance: Flagged answers listed with trace link

requirements.title: Human handoff
requirements.statement: Chat conversations shall be transferable to a live human agent (queue, take-over, return to bot); email drafts go to a review queue.
acceptance: CH-008 reaches the agent queue; agent message appears in customer widget

requirements.title: Agent workspace with AI trace
requirements.statement: The agent workspace shall show the conversation, a context panel (customer, assets, warranty, AMC, open tickets) and the AI trace (tier, intents, evidence, scores, latency) with an editable suggested reply.
acceptance: Trace panel loads within 1 s for any conversation

requirements.title: Ticket and queue views
requirements.statement: The console shall list tickets and conversations with views: needs review, live handoffs, P1, my tickets, all; with status updates.
acceptance: Seed tickets visible and filterable

requirements.title: Handoff summary
requirements.statement: On handoff the system shall generate a short summary (issue, entities, what was tried, why handed off) for the human.
acceptance: Summary shown at top of the conversation in console

requirements.title: Runtime document upload
requirements.statement: Admins shall upload documents (MD, TXT, PDF, DOCX) at runtime; they are parsed, chunked, embedded and searchable without restart.
acceptance: Uploaded SB-2026-12 searchable within 60 s

requirements.title: Structured CSV upload
requirements.statement: Admins shall upload CSVs for error codes, spare parts and FAQs; rows are validated against a schema and upserted to Postgres and Neo4j.
acceptance: new_error_codes.csv creates G5 and L7 linked to existing causes
Invalid rows reported, valid rows applied

requirements.title: LLM graph extraction from documents
requirements.statement: Uploaded documents shall go through schema-constrained entity/relation extraction; proposed KG changes carry provenance (doc, chunk) and confidence and are auto-applied above a threshold or queued for approval.
acceptance: SB-2026-12 yields ErrorCode DHD-E11, parts MT-DHD-ROTOR-R2/RBELT/RMOTOR and REPLACES edge

requirements.title: Ingestion jobs and document management
requirements.statement: The admin UI shall show ingestion jobs (queued, running, done, failed with error), documents with versions, and allow re-index and delete.
acceptance: Deleting a document removes its chunks, cache entries and KG provenance-only facts

requirements.title: Document versioning
requirements.statement: Uploading a new version shall mark the previous one superseded with effective dates.
acceptance: Warranty v1/v2 seed behaves as superseded/active

requirements.title: One-command seed
requirements.statement: `make seed` shall load all mock data into Postgres, the vector index, the FAQ cache and Neo4j.
acceptance: Fresh environment seeded in under 5 minutes

requirements.title: Matsui help centre (Zendesk-inspired)
requirements.statement: A customer help centre shall offer a hero with search, product-family category cards, popular articles, recent service bulletins and contact options (email form, chat launcher), styled with the Matsui theme.
acceptance: Lighthouse accessibility at least 90
Search returns KB articles

requirements.title: KB article pages
requirements.statement: KB documents shall render as articles with heading anchors (citation targets), version badge and related articles.
acceptance: Citation deep links scroll to the right heading

requirements.title: Email contact form
requirements.statement: A contact form (name, company, email, serial optional, subject, message) shall submit into the email pipeline exactly like an inbound email.
acceptance: Submitted form appears as an email conversation and its reply is visible in the demo mailbox (or the Gmail demo inbox when enabled)

requirements.title: Agent console layout
requirements.statement: The agent console shall follow a three-pane workspace: left navigation/views, centre conversation, right context and AI trace panel.
acceptance: Usable at 1366x768

requirements.title: Knowledge admin UI
requirements.statement: Admins shall have pages for uploads, ingestion jobs, documents/versions, FAQ cache entries, pending KG changes and a small KG explorer (neighbourhood view of a node).
acceptance: Upload-to-answer demo can be run entirely from the UI

requirements.title: Analytics dashboard
requirements.statement: An analytics page shall show volume by channel, tier distribution, latency p50/p95 per tier, deflection, handoff rate, groundedness, feedback, cost per conversation, and the RAG vs KG benchmark.
acceptance: Numbers match trace table aggregates

requirements.title: Matsui theme and accessibility
requirements.statement: UI shall use design tokens for the Matsui palette and typography, be responsive (360 px to desktop) and meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
acceptance: Tokens in one file; contrast check passes

requirements.title: Demo controls
requirements.statement: A demo bar shall switch persona (customer of a chosen seed company, agent, admin), reset data to seed and trigger sample emails.
acceptance: Reset restores seed state in under 60 s

requirements.title: Chat latency budget
requirements.statement: Server-side chat latency targets (p95): T0/T1 complete under 300 ms; T2 first token under 1.2 s and complete under 3 s; T3 status message under 500 ms, first answer token under 2.5 s, complete under 6 s.
acceptance: Measured on eval set with 5 concurrent sessions

requirements.title: Email processing time
requirements.statement: Email from receipt to sent reply or queued draft shall take under 60 s at p95.
acceptance: Measured over the 10 sample emails x 3 runs

requirements.title: Fast-path share
requirements.statement: At least 50% of a realistic traffic mix (eval faq + paraphrase + transactional items) shall be served by T0/T1 without a large-model call.
acceptance: Reported by eval harness

requirements.title: Groundedness and hallucination
requirements.statement: Mean groundedness at least 0.90 on knowledge answers; zero fabricated answers on requires_upload items before upload.
acceptance: Eval report

requirements.title: Routing accuracy
requirements.statement: Intent routing accuracy at least 90% and expected-tier match at least 85% on the eval set.
acceptance: Eval report with confusion matrix

requirements.title: Multi-hop accuracy gain
requirements.statement: Hybrid KG-RAG shall be compared with RAG-only on multi_hop/aggregation items; target at least +15 points answer accuracy (the result is reported either way).
acceptance: Benchmark table in eval report

requirements.title: Authentication and roles
requirements.statement: Agents/admins sign in with Google (allow-listed domain or emails) and get role-based access (agent, admin); customers in chat are anonymous or identified by a demo login / verified email.
acceptance: Console routes return 403 without role

requirements.title: Secrets management
requirements.statement: Secrets live in .env (local, git-ignored) and Secret Manager (cloud); none in the repo or images.
acceptance: Secret scan in CI passes

requirements.title: Least-privilege data access for AI
requirements.statement: LLM-driven queries use read-only DB/graph users; tools are an allow-list with typed arguments; no raw SQL from the LLM.
acceptance: Write attempt via Text2Cypher fails at DB level (READ access-mode transaction; read-only user where the Neo4j hosting supports RBAC)

requirements.title: Data minimisation and retention
requirements.statement: Transcripts and traces are retained for a configurable period (default 30 days in POC) and purged by a scheduled job; only demo/synthetic data is used.
acceptance: Purge job deletes expired rows in test

requirements.title: End-to-end request tracing
requirements.statement: Every request produces a trace with spans per graph node (latency, model, tokens, cost, cache hit, tier, scores), stored in Postgres and exportable via OpenTelemetry.
acceptance: Trace viewer in console shows the node timeline

requirements.title: Structured logging
requirements.statement: Services log JSON with request_id/trace_id, level and component.
acceptance: Logs parse as JSON in Cloud Logging

requirements.title: Provider abstraction and fallback
requirements.statement: LLM and embedding providers sit behind an interface with timeouts, retries (one), a fallback model and a deterministic fake provider for tests.
acceptance: Test suite runs offline with the fake provider

requirements.title: Traceability enforced in CI
requirements.statement: tools/sync_docs.py --check shall fail CI if a requirement has no build step, a build step references an unknown requirement, or docs are out of sync.
acceptance: CI job 'traceability' green

requirements.title: GCP-first environments, no local Docker
requirements.statement: No developer machine needs Docker. Backing services (Cloud SQL Postgres + pgvector, Neo4j, GCS, Secret Manager, Vertex AI) run in a GCP dev project; app processes run natively (or in Cloud Shell / Cloud Workstations) against them; images are built by Cloud Build and deployed to Cloud Run for dev and demo environments.
requirements.source: Stakeholder 2026-11-23: no local Docker, keep everything GCP oriented
acceptance: Fresh clone to working dev environment with only gcloud, Python 3.12 (uv) and Node 20 (pnpm) installed
`make deploy-dev` builds in Cloud Build and serves /healthz on Cloud Run
Separate dev and demo environments

requirements.title: Cloud CI/CD
requirements.statement: CI (lint, type checks, unit and integration tests, secret scan, traceability check) and image builds shall run on Cloud Build triggered from the Git repository; integration tests use ephemeral Postgres/Neo4j containers inside Cloud Build, never on developer machines.
acceptance: Cloud Build CI trigger green on main
Images pushed to Artifact Registry with commit SHA tags

requirements.title: Cost visibility
requirements.statement: Token usage and estimated cost shall be recorded per request and aggregated per conversation and per tier.
acceptance: Cost per conversation shown on analytics

requirements.title: Deterministic synthetic dataset
requirements.statement: Mock data shall be generated deterministically by mock-data/generate.py (catalog, KB docs, FAQs, ops, KG, channels, upload samples).
acceptance: Two runs produce byte-identical output

requirements.title: Labelled evaluation set
requirements.statement: An eval set shall cover faq, paraphrase, single-hop, multi-hop (2–5 hops), aggregation, version trap, transactional, safety, out-of-scope, adversarial and requires-upload items, with gold answers, docs and KG paths.
acceptance: eval/questions.jsonl validates against schema

requirements.title: Synthetic data labelling
requirements.statement: All mock records and UI surfaces showing them shall be marked as demo/synthetic; contact details are placeholders.
acceptance: 'Demo data' badge visible in help centre footer and console header
